versions.changelog:
Initial release of support-systems skill.

- Provides a step-by-step guide to build and scale customer support operations for solopreneurs.
- Covers support channel selection, help center setup, SLA targets, automation strategies, and self-service tools.
- Includes ready-to-use templates for common questions and best practices for time management.
- Offers concrete tooling and automation suggestions to reduce support volume and improve efficiency.
- Clearly describes prioritization and triage techniques to manage support queue as a solo operator.
